_readme: Durable holds (scripts/loop/holds.mjs). Every ticket listed here is treated as `blocked` by scripts/loop.mjs, whatever vault/tickets/STATUS.md says, and is written back as `blocked` whenever records.mjs regenerates STATUS.md. To release a ticket, delete its entry here and commit; setting STATUS.md to ready alone does not release it. To hold one, add { ticket, title, reason, question, since }.
